messages:
Ana V: Packaging freeze for private RC4-hotpatch. Delivery window: Thu 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC. We need image pins, cosign signatures, SBOMs, and an airgap sub-manifest. Who will own manifest + parity checks?
Jamal: I can own the manifest and checks. Quick q: do we ship a patch bundle or full installer for airgap?
Liz H: If nothing changes in installer layout or DB schema go patch. If installer binary layout changed we must do full. Any schema changes?
Mike T: No DB/schema changes in this RC — just runtime fixes and backported security patches. Patch bundle OK for our two canaries.
Ana V: Jamal, roll a patch bundle then. Also we must use the new cosign KMS key (cosign-2026-v2). Mike confirm key and rotation window so we don't rotate during delivery.
Mike T: KMS key is provisioned: kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/cosign-2026-v2. Rotation scheduled in May; won't conflict. I will perform signing after upload.
deploy-bot: release artifact built: private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.tar.gz
ops-bot: uploaded to artifactory: https://artifacts.redwood.com/private/rc4/1976005432/private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.tar.gz
Jamal: Uploading patch bundle now: private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.patch.tar.gz and assembling submanifest for airgap delivery (kernel module list, required unpack agent version, checksum files).
Jamal: Generating checksums and signing steps I ran:
```
sha256sum private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.tar.gz > private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.tar.gz.sha256
sha256sum private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.patch.tar.gz > private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.patch.tar.gz.sha256
```
Jamal: Then cosign with KMS:
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/cosign-2026-v2 private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.tar.gz
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/cosign-2026-v2 private-hotpatch-rc4-1976005432.patch.tar.gz
```
Liz H: Please include SBOM (CycloneDX) artifacts and attestations for the repack step. Add a small README that explains upgrade path and verification steps for customers (how to verify cosign sig + sha256).
Mike T: For airgap we must include a submanifest entry enumerating kernel modules, minimum unpack agent (v1.8+), and required SELinux policy state. Jamal add that.
Jamal: Adding submanifest entries and SBOM now. ETA upload + signatures: tonight by 21:45 UTC.
Dana: Canary plan: tag rc4-canary -> images for cust-gamma and cust-delta. Canary push scheduled 23:15 UTC Thu (20 min after delivery), monitor 20m. Rollback criteria: error rate spike > 1.5% OR p95 latency increase > 60ms. Rollback action: revert routing and re-tag images to rc3-stable.
Liz H: Draft a short canary release note we can paste to customers: list of fixes, expected impact (hot patch, no downtime), verification steps, and rollback instructions + oncall contact.
Ana V: Also prep a pre-window checklist: staging smoke deploy + airgap unpack verification at least 1 hour before the push. Jamal & Mike confirm you can do these checks.
Mike T: Confirmed, I'll run staging smoke and the unpack verification. I'll be on the delivery call.
Jamal: Confirmed, I will validate checksums, upload SBOMs, and cosign both artifacts by 21:45 UTC.
ops-runner: canary rollout job created for 2026-04-01 23:15 UTC -> targets: cust-gamma, cust-delta
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled by ops-runner for 2026-04-01 23:15 UTC
Jamal: Upload complete. SHA256 files and cosign signatures attached in the manifest. Cosign key id: cosign-2026-v2 (KMS key path in manifest).
Liz H: Good. Add provenance note in manifest with cosign key ID + signing principal so customers' auditors can verify.
Ana V: I'll send the delivery manifest and the release note snippet to compliance/legal after you push artifacts. If all good, we proceed with canary. :thumbsup:
Dana: I'll watch dashboards and traces during canary. Will escalate immediately if thresholds hit. :eyes:
Ana V: Thanks everyone — closing thread unless blockers appear. Reopen if anything pops up. :shipit:
